RTX, through its Pratt & Whitney Controls & Diagnostic Systems organization, is hiring an Associate Software Engineer I for Engine System Software. The role develops software requirements and designs for gas turbine engine control and diagnostic systems, including requirements decomposition, traceability, prototype testing, reviews, and software planning.
Associate Software Engineer I developing CDS/Engine System Software requirements and designs, documenting traceability, and testing prototypes

Responsibilities:
• Develop software requirements and designs within the Agile Framework:
• Decompose system level and customer interface requirements into software requirements and designs
• Document traceability or rationale for derived requirements and designs
• Conduct iterative prototype testing of requirements and designs
• Perform reviews of requirements and designs
• Participate in software planning, estimating and tracking

Requirements:
• U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are authorized to access information under this program/contract
• A Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering or Computer Science or other STEM degree
• Minimum 3.0 GPA

Preferred:
• Solid track record of achieving results
• Ability to work in a dynamic, high pressure environment
• Good communication skills
• Good teaming skills
